newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shinsho non-ferrous affiliates to merge.
newsitem.headline: Shinsho non-ferrous affiliates to merge.

text.p: Japanese metal trader Shinsho Corp said on Tuesday that two of its non-ferrous metal sales and processing affiliates would merge on October 1 to form a new company, tentatively named Shinsho Non-Ferrous KK.

The move will combine Osaka-based Shinsho Metal Processing KK, which processes and distributes aluminium, stainless steel and copper products, and Tokyo-based Shinsho Non-Ferrous Sales KK, an aluminium sheet and rod distributor.
The new company will have projected sales of 15 billion yen in its first full fiscal year of operations.
